outcome: number of red blood cell (RBC) units transfused within 24 h following childbirth
need for intensive care unit (ICU) admission
cohort: 350 women with placenta previa/anterior low-lying placenta and history of cesarean section(s)
finding: Prophylactic radiologic interventions prior to planned cesarean section may help to limit perioperative blood loss in women with clear signs of placenta accreta spectrum disorder on ultrasonography, but there was no evidence of a difference within the subgroup without such ultrasonographic signs.
